why: The Jetson lost power briefly after this run (about 18:10-18:13) and rebooted on its own. Files still in the write cache were lost: summary.json, contact_sheet.jpg, peak_flame.jpg and the last four snaps came back empty, and node.csv stops after 89 of about 176 rows. The numbers below are copied from console.log, which is complete. contact_sheet.jpg and peak_flame.jpg were restored from copies fetched from the Jetson at 18:10, before the power loss. frames.csv is complete (2605 rows) and carries the node reading in force on every frame, so the sensor series can be rebuilt from it.
note_on_start: The paper was lit before the first frame, during engine start-up, so this run has no scene before the fire and cannot give a time from ignition. T3_fire_181345 is the repeat that does.

timing.note: from safefire_run's own summary line; recording was on
